findings.body: The only test that executes migration 0004 and verifies the multi-plant rollup against PostgreSQL is conditionally skipped here, and the supplied close run records it as `SKIP`; no completed handoff evidence shows a separate pass. The passing hermetic checks only inspect SQL text, so an invalid migration or database-specific view failure can merge without the required proof. Run this test against the designated throwaway warehouse and record the passing result.

findings.body: This line advertises `plant` as a supported grouping dimension, but the unchanged `SqlBuilder.composedCtes` implementation at backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:345-383 projects only `gl_code` and `month`, exposes no `plant` column from `financial_relation`, and joins Actual to Budget only on GL/month. A plant filter or breakdown therefore generates an outer `WHERE`/`GROUP BY plant` against a relation without that column. The story assigns the source filtering, plant projection/join, and golden DUB proof to MP-GL-SQL, so this is deferred P2 work rather than a missing deliverable for this task.
findings.title: Later: MP-GL-SQL must make the advertised plant dimension executable
